name: soft-report
description: Basic Electron desktop application template with Node.js and TypeScript.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/index.js dist/preload/index.js && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --watch dist --ext js --exec electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n TSC,VITE,ELECTRON -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev:electron:compile" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron"
